# Thrift Shoe Wear Admin Portal — Technical Architecture & Operations Spec

> Built with Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Redux Toolkit, and Serwist Offline-First PWA caching.

## Architecture Overview
- Framework: Next.js App Router (`next build --webpack`) with split vendor chunks (`framework`, `redux-vendor`, `radix-ui-vendor`, `recharts-vendor`, `icons-vendor`) under 500 KiB.
- Authentication & RBAC: Token-verified sessions distinguishing standard `admin` operations from `superAdmin` security governance.
- Offline-First Resiliency: `@serwist/next` Service Worker (`sw.js`) caches App Router navigations, API read responses (`NetworkFirst`), and product media (`CacheFirst` up to 150 images / 7 days) while gating mutations until network connectivity returns.
- Super Admin Governance: Immutable action/error/security audit logs (`/logs`) and password-locked live capability toggles (`/features`) controlling shopping cart, wishlist, checkout, sales, coupons, reviews, order tracking, registration, newsletter, and search.
